name: Arca Incursion
description: Infiltrate the mechanical depths of Arca. The machines here follow a logic all their own.

dialog.speaker: Senior Hunter
dialog.text: Command says figure out what this place does. But every terminal I touch just spits out errors in a language nobody reads.

dialog.speaker: Senior Hunter
dialog.text: Half the team wants to rip the servers out for parts. The other half thinks turning them off might make things worse. Nobody knows.
